run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to compute transitive dependencies for all targets in a build dictionary
run_transitive_deps: run the transitive_deps function to recursively compute the full dependency closure for a given lib
run_get_lib: run the get_lib function to look up a library by name from a list of lib dictionaries
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to add transitive_deps to node_modules and other target lists beyond libs
review_transitive_deps: review the transitive_deps function and its recursive set union logic for computing dependency closures
